function mountGuide(onClose: () => void): (step?: number) => void {
  const backdrop = document.createElement("div");
  backdrop.id = "guide-backdrop"; backdrop.hidden = true;
  const card = document.createElement("section");
  card.id = "guide"; card.hidden = true;
  card.setAttribute("role", "dialog"); card.setAttribute("aria-modal", "true"); card.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", "guide-title");
  card.tabIndex = -1;
  document.body.append(backdrop, card);

  let step = 0, spotted: HTMLElement | null = null, open = false;

  const unspot = () => { spotted?.classList.remove("guide-spot"); spotted = null; };
  const spot = (id?: string, cardAt?: "top" | "center") => {
    unspot();
    const el = id ? document.getElementById(id) : null;
    if (!el || el.hidden) { card.className = `at-${cardAt ?? "center"}`; return; }
    el.classList.add("guide-spot"); spotted = el;
    el.scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest", behavior: "auto" });
    // Centred by default; at the top when the spotlight is in the lower half of the screen. Never at the bottom.
    const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    card.className = `at-${cardAt ?? (r.top + r.height / 2 > window.innerHeight / 2 ? "top" : "center")}`;
  };''',

      const k = el.getBoundingClientRect();

      l = Math.min(l, k.left); t = Math.min(t, k.top); r = Math.max(r, k.right); b = Math.max(b, k.bottom); n++;
    }
    return n ? new DOMRect(l, t, r - l, b - t) : null;
  };
  const place = () => {

      frame.className = "";

238:/** The step-by-step guide. Returns open(step, switchToFreePlay) so the strip can replay it. */
239:function mountGuide(onClose: () => void): (step?: number, freePlay?: boolean) => void {
240:  const backdrop = document.createElement("div");
241:  backdrop.id = "guide-backdrop"; backdrop.hidden = true;
242:  const frame = document.createElement("div");
243:  frame.id = "guide-spot"; frame.hidden = true;
244:  const card = document.createElement("section");
245:  card.id = "guide"; card.hidden = true;
246:  card.setAttribute("role", "dialog"); card.setAttribute("aria-modal", "true"); card.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", "guide-title");
247:  card.tabIndex = -1;
248:  document.body.append(backdrop, frame, card);
249:
250:  let step = 0, open = false, selector: string | undefined, raf = 0;
251:  /** While the tour runs the page is pushed down below the card, so nothing is ever under it.
252:   *  The band only grows during a tour, so content does not shift between steps. */
253:  let band = 0, bodyPadding = "";
254:  const reserveBand = () => {
255:    const need = card.getBoundingClientRect().bottom + 16;
256:    if (need <= band) return;
257:    band = need;
258:    document.body.style.paddingTop = `${band}px`;
259:  };
260:  /** The job that was selected when the guide opened; Skip puts it back. */
261:  let previousJob = "";
262:
263:  const PAD = 8;
264:  /** Union of the visible targets' boxes, in viewport pixels. */
265:  const measure = (): DOMRect | null => {
266:    if (!selector) return null;
267:    let l = Infinity, t = Infinity, r = -Infinity, b = -Infinity, n = 0;
268:    for (const el of Array.from(document.querySelectorAll<Element>(selector))) {
269:      if (el instanceof HTMLElement && el.hidden) continue;
270:      const k = el.getBoundingClientRect();
271:      if (k.width === 0 && k.height === 0) continue;
272:      l = Math.min(l, k.left); t = Math.min(t, k.top); r = Math.max(r, k.right); b = Math.max(b, k.bottom); n++;
273:    }
274:    return n ? new DOMRect(l, t, r - l, b - t) : null;
275:  };
276:  const place = () => {
277:    const k = measure();
278:    if (!k) {
279:      frame.className = "none";
280:      Object.assign(frame.style, { left: "50vw", top: "50vh", width: "0px", height: "0px" });
281:    } else {
282:      frame.className = "";
283:      Object.assign(frame.style, { left: `${k.left - PAD}px`, top: `${k.top - PAD}px`, width: `${k.width + 2 * PAD}px`, height: `${k.height + 2 * PAD}px` });
284:    }
285:    if (open) raf = requestAnimationFrame(place);
286:  };
287:  const spot = (sel?: string) => {
288:    selector = sel;
289:    const first = sel ? document.querySelector(sel) : null;
290:    first?.scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest", behavior: "auto" });
291:    // The card never moves, so the page scrolls instead: keep the lit part below the card.
292:    const k = measure(), c = card.getBoundingClientRect();
293:    if (k && k.top < c.bottom + 12) window.scrollBy({ top: k.top - c.bottom - 12, behavior: "auto" });
294:    cancelAnimationFrame(raf); place();
295:  };
296:  const render = () => {
297:    const s = STEPS[step], last = step === STEPS.length - 1, first = step === 0;
298:    card.innerHTML = `
299:      <h2 id="guide-title">${s.title}</h2>
300:      ${s.body.map((p) => `<p>${p}</p>`).join("")}
301:      ${s.fix ? `<div class="fix"><small>${first ? "" : "On the bench"}</small>${s.fix}</div>` : ""}
302:      ${s.manual ? `<p class="manual">Read more in the manual: <a href="${MANUAL}#${s.manual.anchor}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${s.manual.label} ↗</a> (Ciechanowski, <i>Mechanical Watch</i>)</p>` : ""}
303:      <div class="nav">
304:        <span class="dots">${first ? "" : `${step} of ${STEPS.length - 1}`}</span>
305:        ${first ? `<button type="button" class="skip" data-act="skip">Skip, I know watches</button>` : `<button type="button" class="skip" data-act="skip">Skip</button>`}
306:        ${first ? "" : `<button type="button" data-act="back">Back</button>`}
307:        <button type="button" class="primary" data-act="next">${first ? "Start" : last ? "Start fixing" : "Next"}</button>
308:      </div>`;
309:    card.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>("[data-act]").forEach((b) => (b.onclick = () => act(b.dataset.act!)));
310:    reserveBand();
311:    spot(s.spot);
312:    card.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(".primary")?.focus();
313:  };
314:  const close = (finished: boolean) => {
315:    open = false; cancelAnimationFrame(raf); selector = undefined;
316:    card.hidden = backdrop.hidden = frame.hidden = true;
317:    document.body.style.paddingTop = bodyPadding; band = 0;
318:    write(GUIDE_DONE_KEY, "1");
319:    document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
320:    // Finishing loads the first job; skipping puts back whatever was selected before.
321:    selectPuzzle(finished ? "runs-fast" : previousJob);
322:    onClose();
323:  };
324:  const act = (a: string) => {
325:    if (a === "skip") close(false);
326:    else if (a === "back") { step = Math.max(0, step - 1); render(); }
327:    else if (a === "next") { if (step === STEPS.length - 1) close(true); else { step++; render(); } }
328:  };
329:  const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
330:    if (!open) return;
331:    if (e.key === "Escape") { e.preventDefault(); close(false); }
332:    else if (e.key === "ArrowRight") { e.preventDefault(); act("next"); }
333:    else if (e.key === "ArrowLeft") { e.preventDefault(); act("back"); }
334:  };

// Onboarding checks: the first-visit guide (free play, side-docked card, lit parts never covered, nothing
// pushed down, skip, persistence, replay), the hint timer, mobile layout.
import { chromium } from "playwright";
import { createServer } from "vite";
import { createServer as net } from "node:net";
const port = await new Promise((res) => { const s = net(); s.listen(0, () => { const p = s.address().port; s.close(() => res(p)); }); });
const server = await createServer({ root: process.cwd(), server: { port, strictPort: true }, logLevel: "silent" });
await server.listen();
const browser = await chromium.launch();
const out = [];
const check = (name, ok, detail = "") => out.push(`${ok ? "ok  " : "FAIL"} ${name} ${detail}`);
const url = `http://localhost:${port}/`;
const box = (el) => { const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); return { l: r.left, t: r.top, r: r.right, b: r.bottom, w: r.width, h: r.height }; };
const rect = (page, sel) => page.$eval(sel, box);
const frames = (page) => page.$$eval(".guide-frame", (els) => els.map((el) => { const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); return { l: r.left, t: r.top, r: r.right, b: r.bottom, w: r.width, h: r.height }; }));
const contains = (a, b) => a.l <= b.l + 1 && a.t <= b.t + 1 && a.r >= b.r - 1 && a.b >= b.b - 1;
const overlap = (a, b) => a.l < b.r && a.r > b.l && a.t < b.b && a.b > b.t;
const next = async (page) => { await page.click('#guide [data-act="next"]'); await page.waitForTimeout(100); };
try {
  const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 1280, height: 900 } });
  const errs = []; page.on("pageerror", (e) => errs.push(String(e)));
  await page.clock.install();
  await page.goto(url);
  await page.waitForSelector("#guide");
  check("guide opens on first visit", await page.isVisible("#guide"));
  check("guide switches to free play", (await page.inputValue("#puzzle-select")) === "");
  check("free play shows every slider", await page.isVisible("#ctl-beat") && await page.isVisible("#ctl-wind") && await page.isVisible("#ctl-position"));
  check("welcome has Start and Skip", (await page.textContent("#guide .nav"))?.includes("Start") && (await page.textContent("#guide .nav"))?.includes("Skip"));
  check("welcome renders over the page: nothing pushed down", (await page.evaluate(() => document.body.style.paddingTop)) === "" && (await rect(page, ".sheet")).t < 40, JSON.stringify(await rect(page, ".sheet")));
  const cardAtWelcome = await rect(page, "#guide");
  await page.screenshot({ path: "shots/onboarding-live-guide-welcome.png" });

  await next(page);
  check("step 1 is the mainspring", (await page.textContent("#guide h2"))?.includes("mainspring"));
  check("step 1 links the manual", (await page.getAttribute("#guide .manual a", "href"))?.endsWith("#power"));
  check("step 1 frame wraps the wind slider", contains((await frames(page))[0], await rect(page, "#ctl-wind")));

  check("step 2 card does not cover the escapement", !overlap(card, f[0]), JSON.stringify({ card, f }));
  await page.screenshot({ path: "shots/onboarding-live-guide-escapement.png" });

  check("step 3 card does not cover a lit part", !f.some((k) => overlap(card, k)), JSON.stringify({ card, f }));

  check("step 4 is the regulator", (await page.textContent("#guide h2"))?.includes("regulator"));
  f = await frames(page); card = await rect(page, "#guide");
  check("step 4 lights the regulator slider and the balance", f.length === 2 && contains(f[0], await rect(page, "#ctl-regulator")) && contains(f[1], await rect(page, "#movement circle.balance")), JSON.stringify(f));
  check("step 4 card does not cover a lit part", !f.some((k) => overlap(card, k)), JSON.stringify({ card, f }));

All six notes are addressed and deployed to the preview.

What changed - Step 1, welcome: the card now renders over the page. Nothing is pushed down. - Steps 2 and 3, escapement and balance: the card is docked on the right side, off the drawing, so the lit part is never covered. The escapement highlight still wraps the wheel and the fork. - Steps 4 and 5, regulator and stud: these now light two things at once, the slider and the balance in the drawing, with the card off to the side. The lit slider is usable while the guide is open. - Regulator text, rewritten: - "The hairspring is the fine spiral inside the balance ring. It is not drawn here." - "The regulator is a small lever with two pins that grip the spring near its outer end. Only the spring between the pins and the centre does the work." - "Toward F (fast): the working spring gets shorter and stiffer. The balance swings quicker and the watch gains time." - "Toward S (slow): the working spring gets longer and softer. The balance swings slower and the watch loses time." - Card position: it stays in one slot on the right for the whole tour. The one exception is the timegrapher step, where it crosses to the left because the instrument itself is on the right.

Two things I added in the same spirit: the balance step also lights the Timing screws slider, and the positions step lights the balance alongside the Position and Poising controls.

What is deployed: preview at https://onboarding.watchmakers-bench.pages.dev, commit fa50d69, a fast-forward of main. Tests pass 49 of 49, all named states pass, and the e2e script passes 41 checks, including "the card never overlaps a lit part" on every step.

How to test: click "Replay the guide", or clear the localStorage key bench.guide.done, and walk the eight steps.

One honest note on the regulator copy: it says the hairspring is not drawn, because the drawing has no hairspring or regulator pins. If you'd like them drawn, that is a request for the design and physics owners, and I can log it in the handoffs file.

// Probe: on each guide step, sample frame vs target atomically for a second and report scroll changes.
import { chromium } from "playwright";
import { createServer } from "vite";
import { createServer as net } from "node:net";
const port = await new Promise((res) => { const s = net(); s.listen(0, () => { const p = s.address().port; s.close(() => res(p)); }); });
const server = await createServer({ root: process.cwd(), server: { port, strictPort: true }, logLevel: "silent" });
await server.listen();
const browser = await chromium.launch();
try {
  for (let run = 0; run < 6; run++) {
    const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 1280, height: 900 } });
    await page.goto(`http://localhost:${port}/?guide`);
    await page.waitForSelector("#guide");
    for (let step = 1; step <= 5; step++) {
      await page.click('#guide [data-act="next"]');
      const samples = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
        samples.push(await page.evaluate(() => {
          const ring = document.querySelector("#movement circle.balance").getBoundingClientRect();
          const fs = [...document.querySelectorAll(".guide-frame")].map((el) => el.getBoundingClientRect());
          const inside = fs.some((f) => f.left <= ring.left + 1 && f.top <= ring.top + 1 && f.right >= ring.right - 1 && f.bottom >= ring.bottom - 1);
          return { y: Math.round(window.scrollY * 10) / 10, ringTop: Math.round(ring.top), inside, n: fs.length };
        }));
        await page.waitForTimeout(40);
      }
      const ys = [...new Set(samples.map((k) => k.y))], bad = samples.filter((k) => !k.inside).length;
      if (ys.length > 1 || (bad && step >= 3)) console.log(`run ${run} step ${step}: scrollY ${ys.join(" -> ")}, ring outside frame in ${bad}/12 samples, ringTop ${[...new Set(samples.map((k) => k.ringTop))].join(",")}`);
    }
    await page.close();
  }
  console.log("probe done");
} finally { await browser.close(); await server.close(); }

Assistant2026-11-14T07:56:07.809Z

All three requests are done and deployed to the preview.

What changed - Latest main is in. I merged it instead of rebasing: a rebase rewrites the branch, which would need a force push or a new preview URL. The result is the same code, a clean fast-forward of main, at the same URL. - Step 1 is centred on the page again. The other steps stay docked at the side. - Slider steps are tied to the new visuals. Each step lights the drawn part together with its slider, keeps that part glowing red for the step, and tells the reader to drag the slider and watch it: - Mainspring: the red swing arcs around the balance show how far it swings. - Balance: the brass timing screws on the rim. - Regulator: the arm at the edge of the balance, between F and S, moving along the hairspring. - Stud: the dot on its curved track, turning the spring. - Positions: the dashed poising spot on the rim and the gravity marker. - Text updated to match. The regulator and stud steps now point at what is drawn; the "not drawn here" line is gone because the hairspring is now on screen. - Controls reset between steps, so trying one slider does not colour the next step.

One side effect I fixed: the guide switching a fresh page to Free play broke the existing puzzle-solve script. The guide now stays shut for scripted browsers unless the URL has ?guide. Real visitors are unaffected.

What is deployed: preview at https://onboarding.watchmakers-bench.pages.dev, commit 4c64015. Unit tests pass 59 of 59, every named state passes, the solve script solves puzzles 1, 3 and 4, and the guide's e2e passes 48 checks on five consecutive runs.

How to test: click "Replay the guide", or clear the localStorage key bench.guide.done. On step 4, drag the lit Regulator index slider and watch the red arm move between F and S.

The glow is held on by sending synthetic pointer events to the sliders, which works but is indirect. I logged a request in the handoffs file for a small highlight hook from the physics owner.

result: Onboarding branch merged with latest main, welcome centred, slider steps tied to the new drawn parts; live at https://onboarding.watchmakers-bench.pages.dev (tip 4c64015), awaiting feedback or the word to promote.
